$comment: Dev server definitions for this project. Verified working 2026-08-09.
NOTE: there is no established .claude/launch.json schema in Claude Code;
this shape was chosen by hand. Adjust it to match whatever tool consumes it.
Three fixes were required to make this build at all — see notes below.
Do NOT move this repo back into iCloud Drive (~/Library/Mobile Documents):
iCloud evicts file contents ('dataless' files) and Jekyll blocks forever in
read() on the first one it touches. That symptom looks exactly like a hang
with 0% CPU and no error message.

configurations.name: jekyll
notes: --host 0.0.0.0 is what makes it reachable from other devices on the LAN;
Pages live under /note/<slug> and /post/<slug>, not at the root.
